reason: Refuted as framed. It adds nothing to the finals (post-deadline by construction, Q1-Q3 unanswered, exp71 push blocked, CONTEXT l.2539-2544, l.2722-2746). It is also already inside R14L-4 tier 1 item 1 ('first arm = exp71 ... also measures what R9 cost (R14L-8)'), so as a separate item it is a duplicate. Its one real claim, that 'the private delta exp72 - #37 at 3 dp is the only direct measurement of what the retrain ban cost', is wrong on four counts. (1) Wrong estimand. Under the logged 01:31Z governance, exp72 would have become a final only if Q3 = yes AND COMPLETE, L_hi <= 8.0 h, display >= 0.956 and above any V*, AND G2 >= -0.0005 by 29 Sep 12:00Z. The ban's cost is therefore [max(exp72, #38) - max(#37, #38)] on private, times 1[eligible], not exp72 - #37. If exp72 displays < 0.956 on public, the cost is 0 whatever its private score. (2) One noisy draw. Seed variance is +-0.005 (exp16, CONTEXT l.88) against a prior effect of +0.002..+0.003, so SNR < 1. A post-deadline rerun is a new stochastic training draw, not the run that would have happened on 27 Sep. (3) It breaks gates that are already registered. R14L-4's own G0 needs >= 3 seeds per trained arm and a pass above 2x the control SD. I-317 (r12p-4 fix (a)) admits a late sub only at lab >= +0.006 pooled on both embryos, and a retrained arm only after the paired-retrain gate. R14L-8 skips both with a leaky G0-FT kill test: the teacher pilkwang saw 6bba. (4) Two premises are unverified or mis-scaled. Late submissions for this competition are unverified. '+0.001 = 40-60 places' uses public block sizes (63/38/19), while private blocks are unknown. Feasibility is not the problem: nothing is built or submitted before 29 Sep, R1-R10, E10 and the finals are untouched, and 4.5 GPU-h fit the next quota.
